_comment: Registry for the CONTRACT / STAFFING search lane (Phase 1 of the contract-jobs feature; see CLAUDE.md 'Contract/staffing lane'). Same entry shape as companies.json / remote_companies.json. These are staffing / recruiting firms whose public job feeds we monitor for CONTRACT roles (an income-focused search alongside the leadership search). The lane reads THIS file (not companies.json), applies the local+US-remote gate (is_local — keeps Utah-local + US-remote, drops other-metro on-site and international remote), and runs each profile with staffing_search:true. Contract-only filtering happens in the fetcher: fetch_aquent keeps only contract-type placements (placement_type), so this lane is contract work by construction. Each firm VERIFIED to return live contract roles before adding (do not guess). fetch_logos.py reads this file too. Grow the list as more staffing firms are confirmed on reachable JSON/XML feeds (next up: a generalized fetch_bullhorn — Eliassen et al.).
